question: Who among the following has become the Chief Justice of Orissa High Court in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S Muralidhar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **S. Muralidhar has become the Chief Justice of Orissa High Court in January 2021**__.

 __
 
• He is the 32nd Chief Justice of Orissa High Court.
 
• He succeeds **Justice Mohammad Rafiq** as the new chief justice of the Orissa High Court.
 
• He served on the Punjab and Haryana High Court as a judge.
 
• On March 6, 2020, he was appointed to the Punjab and Haryana High Court as a Judge.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hima Kohli** is a Judge of the Supreme Court of India.

 
 
• She served as the Chief Justice of the Telangana High Court in 2021.
 
 
 
• **Sanjib Banerjee** is the Chief Justice of Meghalaya High Court.
 
 
• He also served as the Chief Justice of Madras High Court and a Judge in Calcutta High Court.
 
 
 
• **Justice Pankaj Mithal **is the Chief Justice of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.
